citation: ESA Mars Express HRSC + NASA MGS MOLA blended global DEM, 200 m/px, v2
grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 346 deg
resolution_note: source product is 200 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 20 x 10 source posts and is a 50x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
note: Concentric graben northeast of Isidis, and the strongest clay-mineral exposure on the planet. Contour walking between fault scarps.
